listFolder.description: Read-only listing of a Box folder on the logged-in web app: items with name, id, kind, updated and size; depth > 1 also lists each subfolder (item.children). Opens its own background tab, waits for the SPA (about 8 s per folder), walks serially in that tab, and closes it. Never uploads, moves, deletes or shares.

depth.description: 1 = this folder only (default); 2 = also each subfolder's items; max 4.

returns.description: {path, items:[{name, id, kind:'folder'|'file', updated, size, children?}]}; path is the breadcrumb joined with ' / '; size is the row text ('890.9 KB', or '6 Files' for a folder); children is the nested items array of a folder when depth allows.
